scenarios.name: MARTINEZ/CARLOS MR
speech: I am travelling to the United States today.
Do I need to provide my passenger information before departure?

scenarios.name: SMITH/LUCAS MSTR
speech: My son is 9 years old.
Does he qualify for a child fare?

scenarios.name: JOHNSON/EMILY MS
speech: I travel with your airline every week for business.
I was informed that I have Commercial Important Passenger status.

scenarios.name: BROWN/PETER MR
speech: My mobile number has changed since I made my reservation.
Could you please update my contact details?

scenarios.name: DAVIS/BABY ANNA
speech: My daughter will be travelling on my lap during the flight.
Does she need her own boarding pass?

scenarios.name: DE VRIES/JAN MR
speech: I am travelling on official duty for the Royal Military Police.
My identification documents are available upon request.

scenarios.name: WILSON/ROBERT MR
speech: Good afternoon.
I am a passenger on flight KL686 to Rome.

scenarios.name: LEE/GRACE MS
speech: How many passengers are travelling on today's flight?
The departure lounge seems very busy.

scenarios.name: CLARK/THOMAS MR
speech: I am travelling to South Africa next week.
Where can I find the latest travel requirements?

scenarios.name: ANDERSON/SOPHIA MS
speech: I have been escorted to the lounge by airport staff.
I understand I have been registered as a Very Important Person.

scenarios.name: JONES/ETHAN MR
speech: I'm 15 years old and travelling alone today.
Are there any additional procedures I should know about?

scenarios.name: MILLER/JAMES MR
speech: My ticket says the flight departs at 18:00.
Has daylight saving time already started in Spain?

scenarios.name: WHITE/LISA MS
speech: The operations report lists all times in UTC.
Could you explain what UTC means?

scenarios.name: HARRIS/MARK CAPT
speech: Air Traffic Control provided the weather briefing in Zulu time.
Please convert it to local time for the crew.

scenarios.name: TAYLOR/OLIVIA MS
speech: I need to make changes to my reservation.
Could you please retrieve my Passenger Name Record?
